_comment: Shared golden for tier.ManagedForms (docs/p2-design.md §3.2 condition 5, §3.5). Frozen by the P2 design; owned by P2-TIER. internal/tier tests assert ManagedForms(layout{GOOS, OrgRules=<managed_dir>/ballast/rules.json}, self, extra) == (deny_write, perm_deny) byte-for-byte; internal/install tests (P2-INSTALL) assert that org render's sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite and permissions.deny are exactly these strings for the same inputs. Changing a row is a contract change (architecture §12). v1.5 (docs/p2-design.md §3.2): adds the any-depth forms "**/.ballast" / "**/.ballast/**" and "**/.claude/settings*.json" right after the "./" form of each group; their effect is decided by M0b managed-denywrite-anydepth (conditional contract tier.DefaultWeakenedProject). v1.6 (M0b, Claude 2.1.300): permissions.deny carries only Edit(...) entries (an Edit rule also covers the Write tool; Write(...)/NotebookEdit(...) path entries are warned about as invalid) and a POSIX absolute path inside Edit(...) uses the "//" form (a single leading "/" is not read as a filesystem-absolute path); deny_write keeps the plain absolute path.

cases.name: darwin-symlinked-binary-path-is-literal
cases._note: self is the string the administrator passed to org render --binary (may be a symlink); ManagedForms never resolves it. Detect passes the managed hook's command string after checking EvalSymlinks(command) == EvalSymlinks(Self).

cases.name: windows-render-only
cases._note: native Windows is never T1; the row only pins org render output
